name: rhythm
purpose: A practice round on the shared audio clock: a count-in, the pattern played from profile voices, and a silent cycle for the learner to play.
keys: W starts or stops the round when Start has focus; A and D change the tempo when the tempo slider has focus; Q turns the click on your turn on or off when that button has focus; Enter or Space clicks a button

label.doc: the name above the round; Rhythm when it is not given

pattern.doc: one cycle, one item per beat: a technique id of that profile with a voice, or "rest" for a beat with no stroke. 1 to 32 items, at least one stroke. A strike voice is synthesised. A sample voice plays its recording only when the page holds the assets, as show(spec, assets=folder) does; else its strokes are silent.

tempo.doc: beats per minute at the start, 60 when it is not given. The learner can change it with the tempo slider; a change starts at the next cycle.

count_in.doc: beats of a short click before the first cycle, 4 when it is not given

turns.doc: true when it is not given: after each played cycle comes a silent Your turn cycle of the same length, for the learner to play

cycles.doc: how many times the pattern plays, 2 when it is not given

beats.doc: a key in state, for a list. When the next silent cycle is scheduled, the round writes there the times of its beats, in seconds on the shared audio clock.
